bounds.note: per-output union bound applies to every K16 row-group support (<= n_rec independent 16-input records per output); the one-tile bound only to ONE common partition per set

mask_stats.score_rule: sum |w| over valid slots of the tile, backbone columns excluded; anchor: sum |w| of the row group; backbone: top-2 column sums |w| of the group
mask_stats.tie_break: descending score, stable: ascending flat (group, tile) index; anchors / protected / backbone: lowest index among equal maxima

anchors.note: structural all-output guarantee: a full-support anchor neuron per valid record contains every tuple of its record, so every dense-potential tuple of every output stays covered (support existence only: not multiplicity, weight magnitude or accuracy)

quad_sample_rule: 10,000,000 (50M when the enabled density <= 0.10, else 10M; predeclared)
